title: M-TTS-3: Additional backends (Fish, Higgs, XTTS, Kokoro variants)
description: Add Fish Speech, Higgs, XTTS, Bark, and other TTS backends behind the pluggable interface.

comments.text: Not started. v0 speech demos are Kokoro and Qwen only. Additional backends (Fish, Higgs, XTTS, Kokoro variants) stay open until each is specified and proven.
